language.name: English
startupFailure.title: ImageQueue could not start
startupFailure.message: ImageQueue stopped before opening its main window. Its data was left unchanged. Check the session log, correct the startup problem, then start it again.
rendererFailure.title: ImageQueue could not keep this window open.
rendererFailure.message: Reload the window to recover. Your saved sessions and generated images are unchanged.
draft.persistenceFailed: Recent session changes could not be saved. Keep ImageQueue open and make another edit to retry.
draft.hydrationFailed: The active session’s draft could not be loaded. Switch sessions and return, or restart ImageQueue; no saved session data was changed.
draft.mutationFailed: A session draft change could not be saved. Reload the saved draft before continuing; no stored data was replaced.
failure.settingsSave: Settings could not be saved. Nothing was changed; try again.
failure.sessionsLoad: Sessions could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
failure.sessionResume: This session could not be resumed. The current queue is unchanged; try again.
failure.sessionCreate: A new session could not be started. The current session is unchanged; try again.
failure.sessionDelete: This session could not be deleted. It remains in ImageQueue; try again.
failure.sessionFolder: This session folder could not be opened. Check that it is still available.
failure.conceptsLoad: Concepts could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
failure.conceptDetailsLoad: The selected concept details could not be loaded. Select the facet again to retry.
failure.conceptsChange: The concept library could not be changed. Nothing was deleted; try again.
failure.elaboratorsLoad: Elaborators could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
failure.elaboratorsChange: The elaborator change could not be saved. Nothing was changed; try again.
failure.drawthingsModelsLoad: Downloaded Draw Things models could not be loaded. Try refreshing them.
failure.drawthingsModelsPoll: Downloaded Draw Things models could not be loaded. ImageQueue tries again shortly.
failure.drawthingsCliLoad: Draw Things CLI status could not be loaded. Try again.
failure.drawthingsCatalogLoad: Available Draw Things models could not be loaded. Try again.
failure.drawthingsDownload: The model download could not be started. Nothing was added; try again.
failure.drawthingsBrowse: A model file could not be selected. The current path is unchanged; try again.
failure.drawthingsImport: The model import could not be started. The selected path is unchanged; try again.
failure.advancedElaboratorsLoad: Elaborators could not be loaded. Close Advanced Prompting and try again.
failure.advancedModelsLoad: Draw Things models could not be loaded. Close Advanced Prompting and try again.
failure.advancedElaborate: The prompt could not be elaborated. Your current prompt is unchanged; try again.
failure.advancedQueue: The tasks could not be queued. Nothing was added; try again.
failure.elaborationDefaultsLoad: The shipped elaboration defaults could not be loaded. Your settings are unchanged.
failure.elaborationSave: Elaboration settings could not be saved. Nothing was changed; try again.
failure.dependenciesLoad: Managed tools could not be checked. Close this window and try again.
failure.dependenciesChange: The managed-tool operation could not be completed. The previous state is still shown; try again.
failure.dependenciesCancel: The managed-tool operation could not be stopped. It may still be running.
confirm.title: Confirm
notice.queuePausedMessage: ImageQueue could not save this session’s progress, so it paused the queue before starting anything else. Images already generating will finish. Check that the output location is available and has enough free space, then choose Resume.
notice.elaboratorsResetMessage: Your elaborator settings file was unreadable, so ImageQueue preserved it and restored the shipped defaults. Your edited templates remain in the preserved copy; check the session log for its location.
taskFailure.notSaved: The image was generated, but ImageQueue could not save it. Check that the output location is available and has enough free space, then retry.
taskFailure.missingKey: No {name} API key is set. Add it in Settings, then retry.
taskFailure.refused: {name} refused this prompt. Change the prompt, then retry.
taskFailure.refusedWithReason: {name} refused this prompt (“{reason}”). Change the prompt, then retry.
taskFailure.providerStatus: {name} ended this request without an image and reported “{status}”. Retry it; if the same status returns, change the prompt.
taskFailure.credentials: {name} rejected the configured credentials. Check the API key in Settings, then retry.
taskFailure.rateLimited: {name} is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
taskFailure.timedOut: {name} did not respond in time. Check the connection, then retry.
taskFailure.fileAccess: ImageQueue could not access a required local file. Check the app’s file permissions, then retry.
taskFailure.generic: {name} could not generate this image. Retry it; if the problem continues, check the session log.
taskFailure.unknown: This image could not be generated. Retry it; if the problem continues, check the session log.
cliJob.importStartFailed: The model import could not be started. Check the session log for details.
cliJob.downloadStartFailed: The model download could not be started. Check the session log for details.
dependencies.title: Managed tools
dependencies.intro: ImageQueue manages these for the Draw Things backend. Nothing is installed or updated without your go-ahead.
dependencies.cliDescription: The image-generation engine, from the official Draw Things Community release and verified against its published checksum.
dependencies.recommendationsDescription: Per-model default settings (configs.json) from Draw Things. Without them, generation uses your own defaults.
dependencies.updatesDescription: Checking asks each tool’s source what is current. Nothing is downloaded.
dependencyPointer.cliMissing: The Draw Things CLI is not installed.
dependencyPointer.cliUpdate: A Draw Things CLI update is available.
dependencyPointer.recommendationsUpdate: A recommended parameters update is available.
dependencyPointer.cliUnreadable: The Draw Things CLI version can’t be read.
dependencyPointer.unchecked: The Draw Things tools haven’t been checked.
about.githubFailed: The ImageQueue GitHub page could not be opened. Try the link again.
about.issuesFailed: The ImageQueue issue page could not be opened. Try the link again.
statusNotices.queueBody: {summary}. Their rows in the queue show details and retry options.
statusNotices.queueBodyRetryFailed: {summary}. Their rows in the queue show details and retry options. Retrying the stopped tasks failed.
operation.outputFolderFailed: The output folder could not be opened. Check that it is still available.
operation.queueControlsLoadFailed: Queue controls could not be loaded. Reopen the menu to try again.
operation.queueControlsRefreshFailed: Queue controls could not be refreshed. Reopen the menu to try again.
operation.retryStoppedFailed: Stopped tasks could not be retried. They remain stopped; try again.
operation.enqueueFailed: The task could not be queued. Nothing was added; try again.
operation.uiStateLoadFailed: Window preferences could not be loaded. Nothing was changed; try again.
operation.uiStateSaveFailed: Window preferences could not be saved. The previous values are still active; try again.
operation.viewerCloseFailed: The image viewer could not be closed. Try again.
operation.viewerOpenFailed: The image viewer could not be opened. The selected image is unchanged; try again.
operation.viewerUpdateFailed: The image viewer could not be updated. Close it and try again.
operation.queueCommandFailed: The queue command could not be completed. The current queue is unchanged; try again.
queueControls.pausedHint: The queue is paused, so nothing new will start.
queueControls.stopConfirm: Stop {tasks}? Work in progress is discarded and every stopped task becomes retryable, but a paid backend may still bill calls already in flight.
queueControls.clearConfirm: Remove {tasks}? Unlike stopping, these are not retryable — they are removed. Generating and finished tasks are untouched.
resumeInterrupted.title: Retry Interrupted Tasks

resumeInterrupted.message.one: This session has {count} task that was left unfinished when it was last open. Retry it to re-queue for generation, or leave it stopped to retry individually later.
resumeInterrupted.message.other: This session has {count} tasks that were left unfinished when it was last open. Retry them all to re-queue for generation, or leave them stopped to retry individually later.

settingsLoad.title: Settings could not be loaded

settings.title: Settings
settings.browseFailed: A file or folder could not be selected. Your current setting is unchanged; try again.
settings.uiFontHint: The app interface font. Comma-separated families; the first one your system has is used. Blank uses the built-in default.
settings.autoPreviewHint: Seconds of inactivity before the latest completed image is automatically selected and previewed. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.confirmRemoveHint: Before removing a task from the queue or marking a completed image as kept.
settings.confirmDeleteHint: Before deleting a task and its files.
settings.deleteToTrashHint: Move deleted task files and session folders to Trash instead of permanently deleting them.
settings.dropEmptySessionsHint: Automatically delete the session folder when leaving or quitting if no tasks remain. Honors Delete to Trash.
settings.keepAwakeHint: Prevent the computer from sleeping during long-running work like image generation, model downloads, and prompt elaboration. The display may still turn off.
settings.statusIconHint: Keep ImageQueue running there when the main window is closed. Use the icon to reopen or quit the app.
settings.notificationsHint: Alerts and sounds only fire when the app is not focused.
settings.showNotificationsHint: Display a small popup when generation completes or fails.
settings.playSoundsHint: Play a sound when generation completes or fails.
settings.successSoundPlaceholder: Leave empty to use built-in chime
settings.failureSoundPlaceholder: Leave empty to use built-in tone
settings.endpointHint: Leave empty for the official OpenAI endpoint.
settings.modelsDirectoryPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the app data models folder
settings.drawThingsTimeoutHint: A generation running longer than this is stopped and marked failed. Local renders can legitimately take minutes on large models, so the default is generous (30 minutes).
settings.resetSlugMessage: Replace the slug template with the shipped default?

welcome.lead: ImageQueue generates images through providers you supply. Nothing is configured yet.
welcome.addKeyBody: OpenAI, Nano Banana, Grok, and FLUX each need their own API key from that provider. A column appears here for every key you add.

gates.seedForElaboration: Enter a seed prompt for elaboration.

advanced.elaboratedPlaceholder: Elaborated prompt will appear here. You can edit before queueing.
elabSettings.title: Elaboration Settings
elabSettings.backoffNone: Provide at least one backoff value.
elabSettings.resetMessage: Replace templates, format directives, and numeric settings with the shipped defaults?
elabSettings.batchSizeRange: Batch size must be an integer between {min} and {max}.
elabSettings.concurrencyRange: Concurrency must be an integer between {min} and {max}.
elabSettings.retriesRange: Max retries must be an integer between {min} and {max}.
elabSettings.saveAnywayMessage: {warning} The brainstorm may not work as expected. Save anyway?
elabSettings.discardMessage: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
elabSettings.concurrencyHint: expansion calls in flight at once ({min}–{max}) — lower it if your provider rate-limits
elabSettings.maxRetriesHint: extra attempts after a transient failure ({min}–{max})
elabSettings.backoffHint: comma-separated; if there are more retries than values, the last one repeats
elabSettings.preferNewHint: ask the AI for new concepts instead of reusing ones whose last use has aged out of the reuse window
elabSettings.templatesHelp: Sent to the AI once per batch with placeholders filled in at call time: the combined elaborators ({elaborator}), the seed ({seed}), the drawn concept assignments ({concepts}), the format directive ({format}), the batch size ({n}), and the response shape ({json}).
elabSettings.expansion: Expansion message — one fresh call per batch, grounded in assigned concepts
elabSettings.formatDirectivesHelp: {tag} is built from the chosen format part and length part joined with a single space, so write each as a complete sentence. The format and length themselves are picked in Advanced Prompting.
elaborators.composition.resetMessage: Replace all composition elaborators with the shipped defaults?
elaborators.style.resetMessage: Replace all style elaborators with the shipped defaults?
elaborators.discardMessage: You have an unsaved elaborator draft. Close without saving?
elaborators.name: Name
elaborators.namePlaceholder: Short name shown in the list
elaborators.descriptionPlaceholder: Short hint shown under the name
elaborators.templatePlaceholder: System instruction sent to the text AI.
elaborators.help: Write concrete visual specifics — light, lens, palette, framing — not qualities like “professional” or “believable”, which an image model cannot draw. Test: if two elaborators in the same list could be satisfied by one sentence, they are too abstract to change the picture.
conceptLibrary.deleteConceptMessage: Delete “{name}”? A future generation run may re-discover it — this drops the row and its use history, it does not block the concept.

conceptLibrary.deleteDomainMessage.one: Delete the domain “{name}” and its {count} concept? Use history under it is removed too.
conceptLibrary.deleteDomainMessage.other: Delete the domain “{name}” and its {count} concepts? Use history under it is removed too.

conceptLibrary.deleteFacetMessage: Delete the “{name}” facet entirely — {domains}, {concepts}, and all use history?
conceptLibrary.empty: No concepts yet. They accumulate as Advanced Prompting elaborates prompts; every value the AI finds is recorded here with how often and how recently it was used.
conceptLibrary.facetEmpty: No concepts in this facet yet.

elaborated.deleteAllMessage.one: Remove {count} prompt from this session’s list?
elaborated.deleteAllMessage.other: Remove all {count} prompts from this session’s list?

elaborated.empty: No prompts elaborated in this session yet. Open Advanced Prompting and click Elaborate, or queue with a fresh-elaboration mode, to produce some.
elaborated.deleteHint: Remove this prompt from the session list (or press Delete on the row)
sessions.resumeMessage: Replace the current queue with this session? The current session is kept if it contains any tasks; if it is empty, it is dropped per the “{setting}” setting.
sessions.newMessage: Start a new session? The current session is kept if it contains any tasks; if it is empty, it is dropped per the “{setting}” setting.
sessions.deleteTrashMessage: Move this session folder to the Trash? The session and everything in it — images, metadata, and task records — will be removed from ImageQueue history.
sessions.deletePermanentMessage: Permanently delete this session folder? The session and everything in it — images, metadata, and task records — will be removed from ImageQueue history.
sessions.note: New Session and Resume keep the current session if it contains any tasks; an empty session is dropped per the “{setting}” setting.
sessions.waitForGeneration: Wait for active generation to finish before resuming another session.
